info.name: Pipedrive API v1 Activities Deals API
info.description: Activities are appointments/tasks/events on a calendar that can be associated with a deal, a lead, a person and an organization. Activities can be of different type (such as call, meeting, lunch or a custom type - see ActivityTypes object) and can be assigned to a particular user. Note that activities can also be created without a specific date/time.

item.name: Convert a deal to a lead

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the deal to convert

request.description: Initiates a conversion of a deal to a lead. The return value is an ID of a job that was assigned to perform the conversion. Related entities (notes, files, emails, activities, ...) are transferred during the process to the target entity. There are exceptions for entities like invoices or history that are not transferred and remain linked to the original deal. If the conversion is successful, the deal is marked as deleted. To retrieve the created entity ID and the result of the conversion, call the /api/v2/deals/{deal_id}/convert/status/{conversion_id} endpoint.

response.name: Successful response containing payload in the `data` field

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

request.description: Returns information about the conversion. Status is always present and its value (not_started, running, completed, failed, rejected) represents the current state of the conversion. Lead ID is only present if the conversion was successfully finished. This data is only temporary and removed after a few days.
